name: Les Companions PACO
summary: Wheeled interior painting robot with a lifting mast and a six-axis arm that sprays water-based paint airless onto walls and ceilings up to 3.5 m high, programmed from a 3D scan of the room. Developed by the French start-up Les Companions in partnership with AkzoNobel.

germany.statusNote: Sold, leased or rented on request by the French maker Les Companions (Marcq-en-Baroeul), whose website has a German language version. Rental as a 'performance partnership' starts at €1.20 per m² and includes the robot, 3D scanner, training, support and maintenance; purchase and lease prices are on request. AkzoNobel's brand Sikkens Germany presents PACO on its German website. No German dealer or service partner is named.

sellers.name: Les Companions
sellers.note: 14 rue des Châteaux, La Pilaterie, 59700 Marcq-en-Baroeul, France (contact page). Offers: rental 'performance partnership' from €1.20 per m² (net or gross not stated) and plain sale or lease (contact for prices); both include PACO, the 3D scanner, training with a certified expert, support and maintenance.

specs.label: Weight
specs.conditions: fully loaded; 275 kg without paint and battery

specs.label: Painting rate
specs.conditions: painting without any human handling (maker FAQ)
specs.quote: The current painting speed (painting without any human handling) is 180 m²/h

specs.label: Paint cartridge
specs.conditions: about 180 m² per cartridge depending on the paint
specs.quote: The PACO is fed by paint cartridges with a capacity of 18L

specs.label: Runtime per battery
specs.conditions: two batteries supplied; about 2 h to charge, swap for continuous work
specs.quote: Each battery can operate for 3 hours and takes about 2 hours to charge

specs.label: Kinematics
specs.quote: Evolution of a mobile platform on the ground + elevation + 6 axes arm

specs.label: Spray method
specs.conditions: maker says the equivalent of 1 to 3 coats in a single pass
specs.quote: PACO only uses water-based paints (i.e. paint with no solvent).

specs.label: Obstacle it can pass
specs.conditions: bumps or holes; floor clearance 40 mm
specs.quote: it can pass over obstacles up to 20mm (bumps or holes) and has a floor clearance of 40mm

specs.label: Operating temperature
specs.conditions: the paint may have narrower limits

specs.label: Operator training
specs.quote: PACO can be easily manipulated after a 2-hour training

notes: Dense foam wheels with sprung suspension; passes bumps and holes up to 20 mm and drives over cables and dirt on site floors (maker).
Maker says PACO can be carried up stairs and moved across muddy sites; it does not climb stairs itself. Minimum setback 1.5 m.
Designed for interior painting of large surfaces (schools, offices, hospitals, stores, industrial and premium housing); areas not to be painted must be masked as for manual work.
Guidance manual or automatic (lidar data compared with the scan); remote monitoring over 4G; automatic 12-minute cleaning cycle.
IP 22 except under the robot. Two batteries of 3 h each, swappable.
Sikkens Germany says putty spraying and sanding functions are still in development; the maker's FAQ says PACO can currently paint.

openQuestions: Purchase and lease prices; whether the €1.20 per m² rental rate is net and what minimum area or term applies.
Does Les Companions deliver, train and service in Germany? The German page of the site carries the English text; no German partner is named.
Sikkens Germany (undated page) says PACO is 'kurz vor der Markteinführung' while the maker says it can be bought or rented now; are putty spraying or sanding available yet?
Arm payload and the highest ceiling it can paint are not stated beyond the 3.5 m working height.
